title: Happy New Year & creator opportunities
summary: The community celebrated the New Year and a short-form Minecraft creator partnership opportunity was announced.
description: Alongside New Year wishes, Minecraft Bedrock and MCPE short-form creators were invited to express interest in a content partnership program.

body.text: TheySix wished the entire community a Happy New Year.
Minecraft Bedrock and MCPE creators working on TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels were invited to take part in a content partnership opportunity.
